newsitem.title: UK: CIBC Wood Gundy adds two managers in Europe.
newsitem.headline: CIBC Wood Gundy adds two managers in Europe.

text.p: CIBC Wood Gundy said on Monday Mark Hopkinson has joined its Global Asset-Based Finance Group in London as managing director.
He co-heads the group's European business activity, with Edmond Horsey, director, who recently moved from the firm's New York office to London.
Hopkinson has responsibility for developing and implementing tax-based structured financing opportunities, while Horsey focuses specifically on leasing opportunities.
Both report to Mark Cosens, managing director and head of Global Asset-Based Finance.
Hopkinson was previously director in the corporate finance division of Macquarie Securities (UK) Ltd in London.
CIBC Wood Gundy is a unit of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.
